title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #5

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the essence of a scripture mean? (1 mark)
   A. Its price
   B. Its cover
   C. Its length
   D. Its most important message

2. Which principle is about the Supreme Soul? (1 mark)
   A. Prani Daya
   B. Prarthana
   C. Paramatma
   D. Punarjanam

3. In which month of the Indian traditional calendar is Maha Shivratri celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. Phalguna
   B. Chaitra
   C. Bhadrapada
   D. Kartika

4. What does Daya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness or compassion
   B. Speed
   C. Wealth
   D. Anger

5. What does Sadachaar mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. Daily prayer
   C. Good conduct
   D. A holy river

6. The Indian traditional calendar is based on what? (1 mark)
   A. Only the stars of the south
   B. The Moon and the Sun
   C. Only the rain
   D. The school year

7. How many Purusharthas are there? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Two
   C. Ten
   D. Five

8. Which of these is a way of following Artha? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Wasting food
   C. Saving pocket money and not taking what is not yours
   D. Cheating

9. Which day is linked with Jupiter? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Thursday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Saturday

10. In a maize farm, what does the wind that carries pollen represent among the elements? (1 mark)
   A. Vayu
   B. Jal
   C. Agni
   D. Prithvi

11. What is a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. A musical instrument
   B. A type of food
   C. A holy book with teachings
   D. A kind of festival

12. Maha Shivratri is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Sikhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Buddhism

13. What does the Gayatri Mantra compare wisdom to? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A river
   C. A drum
   D. Light

14. From which Veda does the Gayatri Mantra come? (1 mark)
   A. Dhammapada
   B. Ramayan
   C. Atharva Veda only
   D. Rig Veda

15. Which day is linked with Mercury? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Wednesday
   C. Friday
   D. Tuesday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Match the days to the heavenly bodies: Ravivaar, Somvaar, Mangalvaar. (3 marks)

17. Give two lessons of the Bal Kaand. (2 marks)

18. Draw and label a simple Mandir. Name four features you would show. (4 marks)

19. Write three ways in which a child can practise Prani Daya. (3 marks)

20. Describe how Maha Shivratri is celebrated. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Its most important message
   The essence is the main lesson inside.

2. C — Paramatma
   Paramatma is God.

3. A — Phalguna
   Phalguna, in February or March.

4. A — Kindness or compassion
   Daya is compassion.

5. C — Good conduct
   Sadachaar is the way a good person behaves.

6. B — The Moon and the Sun
   It is lunar and solar.

7. A — Four
   There are four.

8. C — Saving pocket money and not taking what is not yours
   Artha is honest wealth.

9. B — Thursday
   Guruvaar.

10. A — Vayu
   Wind is air, which is Vayu.

11. C — A holy book with teachings
   Scriptures hold the wisdom of great teachers.

12. C — Hinduism
   It is a Hindu festival.

13. D — Light
   Wisdom is like light that clears away darkness.

14. D — Rig Veda
   The Gayatri Mantra comes from the Rig Veda.

15. B — Wednesday
   Budhvaar.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sun, Moon, Mars.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Respect for parents and teachers, love between brothers, courage to protect others, obedience to wise guidance (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hall, a spire, a door with steps, a bell or flag, and the murti room (any four labelled).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct feature labelled.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give water to thirsty animals, share food, help a hurt friend, do not harm insects, care for plants (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: People fast, keep an all-night vigil, bathe the Shiva Linga with water and milk, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya and visit the Mandir.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice.
